question: Estimate human transcript abundances from the FASTQ files using Salmon, and provide a summary table of the top 10 expressed transcripts.

expected_output.guidelines: TPM and NumReads per transcript must match within 1% relative absolute error; header comment lines, row order, and column order may differ.
The same 10 transcripts as the reference (by TPM rank) must be present, with values matching within 1% relative absolute error; column order may differ.
